text.tspan: Secrets across environments: one store per env account, synced into the cluster, never in Git
RBAC: no get secrets for devs)
RBAC: no get secrets for devs)
RBAC: no get secrets for devs)
ExternalSecret manifests: names/paths only, no values
per-env values file picks /dev/ vs /prod/ path
CI secrets: GitLab CI variables (masked, protected,
environment-scoped) or OIDC → AWS role, no static keys
separate account + KMS key per env: dev can't read prod
scan for leaks: gitleaks / pre-commit, GitLab secret detection
never: plain env in Dockerfile, values in Helm values, logs
